pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): Resource.$(br2)Drops come out $(item)smelted$() when the recipe allows it: ores to ingots, sand to glass and so on. The recipe lists show what each one smelts to ("Smelter:").$(br2)Other cards can build on it: some cards need the Smelter card on the same farm.$(br2)$(thing)Ingredients$(): 6 iron ingots, 1 blaze powder or blaze rod, 1 flint and steel, 1 netherrack.
